name: Elfhame: The Cruel Prince
overview:
IF I CANNOT BE BETTER THAN THEM, I WILL BECOME SO MUCH WORSE.

Jude is 17 years old and lives at the High Court of Domelfe in the kingdom of Terrafae. Kidnapped from the mortal world when she was just a child and raised alongside her sisters among the powerful folk, she has learned to protect herself from enchantments and to fight with a sword. Yet, day after day, she endures mockery and insults.
